originalTitle: Watch: The Mbappé-Chairman Mao controversy explained
summary: Kylian Mbappé has apologised for "ill-judged" comments he made about late Chinese leader Mao Zedong.
content:
Footballer Kylian Mbappé has apologised for "ill-judged" comments he made about late Chinese leader Mao Zedong, which led to him being dropped by several Chinese brands.

China's foreign ministry has also criticised the player.

The BBC's China correspondent Stephen McDonnell explains the controversy.
chineseTitle: 观看：姆巴佩与毛主席之争的解释
chineseSummary: 基利安·姆巴佩为他对已故中国领导人毛泽东的“错误判断”言论道歉。
chineseContent:
足球运动员基利安·姆巴佩 (Kylian Mbappé) 为他对已故中国领导人毛泽东的“错误判断”言论道歉，这些言论导致他被多个中国品牌抛弃。

中国外交部也批评了这名球员。

BBC 驻华记者史蒂芬·麦克唐纳 (Stephen McDonnell) 解释了这一争议。
